quantile_norm_sensitivity.interpretation: AUROC is rank-based; quantile normalization of active genes changes absolute scores but should barely move AUROC, confirming discrimination survives the batch shift while the operating threshold does not.

composite_context: Prior frozen composite IMMUNE_ACCESS=0.40*TCELL_GPS-0.35*MYELOID_FLOOD-0.25*STROMAL_CAGE was NOT_SUPPORTED across 9 configs (GSE63885 platinum AUROC 0.549z/0.579raw, p=0.474/0.239). Core-13 Elastic Net (0.638) is a DIFFERENT model; both verdicts real.
caveat: Batch shift ~4.5 log2 on CXCL12/POSTN breaks frozen Youden threshold (sens 0.00-0.07, spec 1.0) but not rank-based AUROC. Deployment needs cross-cohort calibration.
